scripts.build: npm run vendor && tailwindcss -i assets/styles/site.css -o static/css/site.css --minify
scripts.dev: npm run vendor && tailwindcss -i assets/styles/site.css -o static/css/site.css --watch
scripts.vendor: mkdir -p static/vendor/fontawesome && cp node_modules/htmx.org/dist/htmx.min.js static/vendor/htmx.min.js && cp node_modules/alpinejs/dist/cdn.min.js static/vendor/alpine.min.js && cp -R node_modules/@fortawesome/fontawesome-free/css node_modules/@fortawesome/fontawesome-free/webfonts static/vendor/fontawesome/
